definition: Transmitted like a telegraph signal or conveying messages through wires.
author: Kenneth Grahame
quote: He stopped dead in his tracks, his nose searching hither and thither in its efforts to recapture the fine filament, the telegraphic current, that had so strongly moved him.
example_sentence: A telegraphic buzz ran through the office when the cake arrived.
